subject: general
question: B's mother is the daughter of F. C is the son of F and D. G is the son of C and E. D is the mother of R. How is F related to G?
solution:
Family chart :-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/749b5b689090c8a303af7be8d3e16c0fd60e1068fd8dc460dddfc628895fff49.png] 

Family Tree :

1) C is the son of F and D and G is the son of C and E.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2b34bddd8500920332671061bffd13d92b852f07fe8e623c87d76020ca040118.png] 

2) D is the mother of R and B's mother is the daughter of F.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/92c1718f3e2e6fee0caf832499fbf718ad83b907f05ac0598f53952da858e2f6.png] 

∴ Here, 'F' is paternal grandfather of 'G' and paternal grandfather = father's father.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Father's father".**
